detail.title: Refined Coarse-Grained Dissipation Bounds and Finite Relaxation
detail.summary: This revision incorporates coarse-graining as a fundamental filter on entropy production estimation. We find that accessible state information—limited by coarse-graining—prevents exact entropy reconstruction, forcing reliance on lower bounds. These bounds are robustly computable via convex duality on trajectory observables, independent of rate matrix assumptions, establishing a clearer link between prediction and dissipation.
detail.reason: Incorporating coarse-graining limits into the existing framework of dissipation bounds.
